conditions.quantile: linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy default); harness/compare-fixtures.mjs uses the nearest lower rank

gate.bar: none: T3.1b and T3.1c measure the floors that Gate 3 (10.3) is read against
gate.measured: standard tier, embers on: floor at or above the 10.3 bars from 1,800 s (23 of 30 draws above the 1 % cells bar at 4 h); fast tier: floor zero to 2 h
gate.why: no gate belongs to T3.1; the proposals below are for the owner and section 10.3 is unchanged

notRun: Chromium arms for the -noembers scenarios and for any seed outside 12, 13, 14 (and Warrumbungles 13)
embers-off cells beyond seed 13 with 5 draws (indicative only)
engines other than V8 (Firefox, Safari / JavaScriptCore), and any phone
noise models other than the per-call libm-sized one of T3.1a; .NET Math itself
the tier high and the 3 km fast scenario

proposalForTheOwner.note: Section 10.3 of the plan is not changed. These are proposals read from the floors in this file.
proposalForTheOwner.fastTierEmbersOnOrOff: keep all bars; at 4 h allow 1.5 % of cells (floor maximum 1.33 % in 1 of 35 draws)
proposalForTheOwner.standardTierEmbersOff: keep cells 2.5 %, area 2.5 %, median 30 s at all horizons; p95 60 s to 2 h (floor max 20 s), 200 s at 4 h (floor max 182 s); 1 seed, 5 draws
proposalForTheOwner.standardTierEmbersOn1800sTo4h: no per-run bars (floor 1 to 40 times the bar); judge by the ensemble mean of burnt area over N seeds: about 6 % at 2 h and 4 % at 4 h for N = 30 (single-draw signed area sd 9.2 % at 2 h, 5.1 % at 4 h); the plan's 12 % is much wider than the noise
